# Teh_Bucket boar

- Source page: https://opengameart.org/content/boar

- Original SHA-256: `c16625680d056f0402d1be209c41d16a63394aec94b082a63ad32f562e9f2d2d`
- Browser GLB SHA-256: `b3105d289d000451f88c813c3ed78b73782c7f8700acbb37a129b592629f189c`

The source is a textured, rigged, approximately 1k-triangle wild boar with
`walk` and `attack` actions. `boar.glb` was exported from the exact source in
Blender 5.1.1. The packed `boar` texture was connected to the Principled BSDF
base color before GLB export because the 2015 Blender material used a legacy
texture connection that current glTF export does not recognize. Geometry,
skeleton, texture, and authored actions are otherwise unchanged.
